mapper.select: SELECT s.StudentId, s.StudentCode, s.FullName, s.Gender, s.DateOfBirth, s.ClassId, c.ClassName, s.Hometown, s.ParentName, s.ParentPhone, s.BoardingStatus, s.UserId, s.CreatedAt, s.UpdatedAt FROM Students s INNER JOIN Classes c ON s.ClassId = c.ClassId WHERE s.StudentId = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Students ( StudentCode, FullName, Gender, DateOfBirth, ClassId, Hometown, ParentName, ParentPhone, BoardingStatus ) VALUES ( #{studentCode}, #{fullName}, #{gender}, #{dateOfBirth}, #{classId}, #{hometown}, #{parentName}, #{parentPhone}, #{boardingStatus} )
mapper.update: UPDATE Students SET StudentCode = #{studentCode}, FullName = #{fullName}, Gender = #{gender}, DateOfBirth = #{dateOfBirth}, ClassId = #{classId}, Hometown = #{hometown}, ParentName = #{parentName}, ParentPhone = #{parentPhone}, BoardingStatus = #{boardingStatus}, UpdatedAt = SYSDATETIME() WHERE StudentId = #{studentId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM Students s INNER JOIN Classes c ON s.ClassId = c.ClassId ORDER BY s.StudentId DESC
